Using the **subagents** skill.

**Fit check:** before spawning parallel members, I need a **single-pass rival** — one agent with a deeper primary pass in one context.

For this job (map auth flow in one service), a single agent can read callers, tests, and handlers sequentially. Members would duplicate the same repo slice without independent sources or kill mandates.

**Decision:** skip parallel spawn; run one thorough explore pass instead of `N ≥ 2` Tasks.

If you need cross-repo or multi-source gather with truly independent slices, say so and I will name why the single-pass rival is insufficient.
